dedupe_keys.name: yunnan gnss normal interference and spoofing observations 2023

description: Yunnan University publishes normal and disrupted GNSS observations from a receiver on the fifth floor of its Science Hall in Kunming. Three Mendeley deposits form one collection: raw observations from 12–20 and 21–30 September 2023, processed September observations, and controlled interference and spoofing tests on 21 December 2023. Five satellite constellations and eight signal bands are documented. Variables include carrier-to-noise ratio, Doppler, pseudorange, carrier phase, satellite status and position. The current part III release includes JSON files, daily ZIP containers and MATLAB and Python support files. All inspected parts state free CC BY 4.0 access. Coverage is one receiver location and controlled conditions, limiting inference about airport-wide or operational outage frequency. Modellers could evaluate positioning-error detection and resilience components against the observed responses. platform-gnss-sdr and data-jammertest-andoya-gnss-resilience-test are related resources. No observations, interference-generation tools or scripts were downloaded or executed.
